title: Swiss NCSC reports first cyberattacks on Swiss organisations carried out with AI agents
date_note: Date is the day the NCSC published its notice; the page gives no earlier day for the attacks, which it places 'in recent days'.
geo_basis: country named by the Swiss NCSC; no victim city is given
summary: Switzerland's NCSC says it has received its first reports of cyberattacks on organisations in Switzerland carried out with AI agents; several organisations and critical infrastructure operators in at least two sectors were affected. The NCSC says that in every attack it knows of, the agents led to a successful compromise of the victims' IT systems. It names no victims and gives no total.
plain: Switzerland's cyber agency says it has received its first reports of attacks run with AI agents. Several organisations, including critical infrastructure operators, were affected, and in every known case the attackers got into IT systems.
exec: The Swiss NCSC says AI-agent attacks hit organisations and critical infrastructure operators in at least two sectors and succeeded in every case it knows of.
action: The NCSC advises limiting internet-facing systems, installing critical updates on them without delay, requiring MFA or passkeys for internet-accessible resources such as webmail and VPNs, and using least privilege and regular testing.

validation.note: The NCSC's own notice was read; Security Affairs relays it.
